scope: Qt resistance and propulsion workflows, original numerical-engine integration, parameters, plots, cancellation, persistence and report exports. Twelve primary sample methods complete; unavailable legacy branches remain explicit.
limitations: CALCPROP tasks 1, 2 and 3: the identified external binary exits without result files even in an independent ASCII-path replay; numerical outputs remain not_run.
Troost B-series uses an incompatible legacy DOS solver. Planing Almeter and three advertised multihull methods have no original dispatch implementation.
Numerical formula certification, Hydrodyn specialist tools and the rest of the migration remain outside this delivery.
Hidden Windows Qt widgets, image inspection and PDF rendering do not replace actual desktop input and full visual-fidelity acceptance.
External solvers are referenced through local calculation-tools.json only and are not redistributed in this package.
notes: After the complete performance suite, the only source change separated an existing early-return condition and assignment onto separate lines; execution order and conditions were unchanged.
The final rebuilt package and actual installed directory were validated directly against retained workflow references.
The basic migration suite preceded the final performance-dialog-only choice refresh; the installed editing workflow was then checked directly.
Legacy fs, the accepted Qt pilot, user models and user settings were not replaced.
Reusable tests, deterministic fixtures, independent original entrypoint observers and solver diagnostics are retained under FreeShip-Tests and integrated as qt-performance.
